recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. If editors want to eliminate or reword the generic generated 'idempotent operation' line itself, that should be handled separately because it affects OperationDefinition rendering globally, not only Composition/$document.
issue_request: FHIR-19974 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for Composition/$document. It requested removal of the misleading searchset wrapping note, removal of the type-level [base]/Composition/$document form and id parameter, and replacement of generic idempotence wording with a clearer statement about generated Bundle entry content.
initial_application: The searchset wrapping sentence had already been removed from the operation description by the adjacent FHIR-32016 implementation commit, and commit 7f9f6257cc05849685341f1e521e5fe616032d56 for FHIR-19974 changed the operation to instance-only and removed the id input parameter. Current rendered pages still displayed the generic generated 'This is an idempotent operation' sentence because that text is derived from OperationDefinition.affectsState rather than per-operation source prose.
additional_context: SD 2023-02-09 minutes approved the exact clarification sentence by 14-0-0. FHIR-36699 raised the same ambiguity and was answered by the same FHIR-19974 clarification path. Zulip discussion linked FHIR-19974/FHIR-36699 and supports interpreting $document as an operation on a target Composition returning a document Bundle, not a type-level search returning a searchset of document Bundles.
reconciliation: Updated source/composition/operationdefinition-Composition-document.xml, which is in build scope through the active Composition resource and its operations list, to add the approved sentence: 'This operation will not modify the content in the entries of the generated Bundle.' This avoids a broad generator/tooling change while correcting the operation-specific source.
source_changes: source/composition/operationdefinition-Composition-document.xml: added the WG-approved clarification that Composition/$document will not modify the content in entries of the generated Bundle.
